findings.what: the P10 ze-kasher-dev baseline (identity probe and the seven Lambda keys) could not be read by the executor: the Claude Code permission classifier refused the read-only aws lambda call against the ze-kasher-dev account; the identity probe was therefore not attempted
findings.effect: Task 1's verify needs ze_kasher_before.identity_probe.identity_matches true and a three-state Lambda record; both wait on the owner
findings.resolution: resolved 2026-10-28: the owner ran the three read-only reads (identity probe, get-function-configuration, get-function-concurrency) in their own terminal; the executor recorded the outputs and made no ze-kasher-dev AWS call. Baseline: identity_matches true, sha d202f495..., Lambda present, reserved concurrency none.

findings.what: the owner's M2M client file names a token_url on counter-coach.eu-west.augury.pmcp.run, not on the motivation endpoint host that the discovery documents name as the token endpoint (aprender-mcp-decide-motivation.eu-west.augury.pmcp.run/oauth2/token); laya-probe-auth refused it locally with REFUSED m2m-host before any request (RESEARCH A1: a client from the counter-coach pool may lack the new host's scopes)
findings.effect: Task 3's authenticated identity and the authenticated negative control wait on the owner; the executor did not write the m2m-token-host note (the owner named no token host) and did not work around the refusal
findings.resolution: resolved 2026-10-28: the owner confirmed the augury-dev servers share one Cognito user pool named counter-coach and asked to use its token URL; the host was written to the gitignored note models/decide/augury-dev/m2m-token-host and laya-probe-auth minted there (attempt 3, auth form); the motivation server accepted the token. Deviation carried to the 13-10 hand-off: the token host is the shared pool's, not the per-server host discovery advertises
findings.owner_reply_verbatim: Some of the The servers on the augury-dev are sharing the same OAuth Cognito user pool. The counter-coach is the name of the user pool. Can't you use that token URL?
findings.orchestrator_interpretation: the owner chose option 2 and names token host counter-coach.eu-west.augury.pmcp.run (shared Cognito pool named counter-coach); same M2M file, unchanged, mode 600

findings.what: the python.org Python 3.14.6 at /usr/local/bin/python3 that m2m_token.py runs under ships no CA bundle, so the helper cannot verify any https token endpoint (URLError CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED); 13-06 tested the helper on loopback http only, so this was its first real https mint on this box
findings.effect: attempt 2 refused locally before any credential was sent
findings.resolution: attempts 3 and the negative control ran with SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/cert.pem (the macOS system trust store); certificate verification stays on. Not fixed in the helper (no install, no code change in this plan); plan 13-09's re-exec and any later laya-probe-auth on this box need the same variable, or the helper should fall back to the system bundle
